g.text: Hazard Identification and Mitigation Effort Using
Review of ECPs, Change Notices, Deficiency

svg.text: Generated by tools/previews/record_figures.py from standards/tailoring/mil-std-882e.yaml and standards/mil-std-882e/model.yaml. Drafted at independence level I0; nothing shown here is reviewed,

g.text: Terms: AI = artificial intelligence (here, an AI assistant drafting at independence level I0) · DoD = US Department of Defense · ECP = engineering change proposal · EMD = engineering
and manufacturing development (acquisition phase) · G0–G7 = lifecycle gate (G0 concept to G7 change and sustainment) · I0–I3 = review independence level (I0 none, e.g. the author or
an AI, to I3 independent organisation) · MIL-STD-882E = US DoD Standard Practice for System Safety (11 May 2012, base edition) · MSA = materiel solution analysis (acquisition phase) ·
ROLE-nnn = project role in the tailoring record (simulated until the lead says otherwise) · TD = technology development (acquisition phase) · US = United States
